original_text:
5. These flower names should be inputted in the following order,
Gladiolus, Lantana, Hyacinth, Iris, Columbine
and inserted into a binary tree in such a way that an inorder traversal of the binary tree visits
the nodes in alphabetical order of the names.
Sketch the resulting binary tree. [3]
